title: 第10章 大团结
slug: 驱鬼道长全本免费-驱鬼道长最新章节列表
content_zh:
我妈一听我的魂吓丢了，就赶紧求王婆子想办法，我爸想了想，从裤兜里掏出一张10块钱的大团结，一把塞进王婆子的手里，也说着好话求她。
王婆子倒也没客气，收下钱后说：“这事有点奇怪，咱们先别冒失给双喜叫魂，我请来仙家查查什么原因再作打算也不迟。”
我爸妈一听，连忙小鸡啄米般点了点头。
王婆子脱了鞋子，爬上炕，盘腿往那一坐，又吩咐我妈拿了一个香炉放摆她的身前，并且点上三柱香。
“一会仙家问你们两口子话，你们别害怕，该咋说就咋说。”王婆子嘱咐我爸妈一句，对着身前的三炷香拜了拜，随即眼睛一闭，嘴里便自言自语起来。
她说话的语速极快，叽里咕噜的说了一大通，都是一些正常人听不懂的话，过了一会儿，她的身体又紧跟着猛地一阵颤抖，牙齿咬的咯咯直响，随之又是打嗝又是流鼻涕的，看上去古怪至极，显然，王婆子正在被仙家附身呢。
不过那时我爸妈也是第一次遇到顶仙儿这种情况，直愣愣的看着王婆子在那魔魔怔怔的自言自语，是一声都不敢吭，大气不敢出，生怕惊动了仙家惹的对方怪罪。
说到顶仙，作者我也在这多嘴几句，大家好奇的话可以看看。
顶仙在我们东北这也叫跑马仙，俗称搬杆子，顶香火头，领兵带队的。
南方称为出壳，落座，放桌等，随着地域的不同，叫法也很多，但最终都是一个目的，有一个弟子（也称弟马）带领一个仙家的堂口，为苦主查事看病解灾等等。
出马一般都是北方比较普遍，南方极少，所以素有南茅北马之称，出马是指一些动物仙，例如狐狸，蛇，黄鼠狼等，在深山野林修炼数百年，然后为自身修炼或接受上天正神的任务，来到凡尘积累功德，以求自身达到位列仙班，成为正修仙神的目的。
动物仙中以胡黄蟒常最为多见，道行最高，所以被世人称为四大家族，相传家族内又以胡三太爷，胡三太奶最为著名，负责统领及监管天下出马的仙家。
为了修行或者接受了任务，仙家想积累功德，修成正果，普度世人，但又不方便直接幻化成人，以免惊世骇俗，所以他们选择有仙缘和悟性的人类做为香童，来与其相互配合，以附体的形式来度化世人，像王婆子便是这一类人。
好了，就讲到这里，废话不多说进入正题。
只见王婆子胡言乱语了一会，她猛地的睁开眼睛，嘴里不停的打着嗝，断断续续的说道:“呃，你们，呃，二人把我请来所谓何事啊？”
此时，王婆子的声音非常生硬，并不是她之前的声音，非男非女，语气有些发尖，还有点生涩。
我妈知道王婆子已经顶上仙了，连忙指着昏迷不醒的我，说:“仙家，麻烦你帮忙看看，双喜这孩子是咋回事，刚才还好好的，冷不丁的就晕倒了，喊都喊不醒他。”
王婆子看了我一眼，轻轻的嗯了一声，随即闭上眼睛，伸出手放在膝盖上捻动，掐算起来。
过了一会，她睁开眼睛说道:“这孩子，呃，是魂丢了不假嘛，不过魂魄，呃，去了不该去的地方，那地就算我，呃，也不敢走上一遭，这事，呃，不好办啊。”

content_en:
My mother was frightened when she heard that my soul was gone, and she quickly begged Mrs. Wang to find a way. My dad thought for a while, took out a 10-dollar bill from his trouser pocket, stuffed it into Mrs. Wang's hand, and begged her with nice words.
Mrs. Wang was not polite at all. After accepting the money, she said: "This is a bit strange. Let's not rush to call Shuangxi's soul first. I'll invite you to the Xian family to find out what the reason is and then make plans."
When my parents heard this, they nodded like chickens pecking at rice.
Mrs. Wang took off her shoes, climbed onto the kang, and sat cross-legged there. She then ordered my mother to bring an incense burner, place it in front of her, and light three sticks of incense.
"The immortal family will ask you two what to say later, don't be afraid, just say what you need to say." Mrs. Wang told my parents, bowed to the three sticks of incense in front of her, then closed her eyes and started talking to herself.
She spoke very fast, mumbling a lot, all of which were words that normal people could not understand. After a while, her body suddenly trembled again, her teeth chattered loudly, followed by hiccups and a runny nose. She looked extremely weird. Apparently, Mrs. Wang was being possessed by the immortal family.
However, it was the first time my parents encountered Ding Xian'er's situation at that time. They stared blankly at Mrs. Wang talking to herself in a daze, not daring to say a word or being angry, for fear of disturbing the Xian family and causing the other party to blame her.
Speaking of Dingxian, I, the author, have a few words to say here. If you are curious, you can take a look.
Dingxian is also called Paomaxian in our Northeast. It is commonly known as the one who carries poles, holds incense and fire heads, and leads troops.
In the south, it is called coming out of the shell, sitting down, setting the table, etc. Depending on the region, there are many names, but in the end they all have the same purpose. There is a disciple (also called Di Ma) who leads a hall of the immortal family to investigate the sufferings of the suffering master, provide medical treatment and relieve disasters, etc.
Chuma is generally more common in the north, but rare in the south, so it is known as Nanmao and Northma. Chuma refers to some animal immortals, such as foxes, snakes, weasels, etc., who practice in the deep mountains and wild forests for hundreds of years, and then practice for themselves or accept the mission of the gods from heaven, and come to the mortal world to accumulate merit, in order to achieve the goal of ranking among the immortals and becoming a true cultivator.
Among the animal immortals, Hu Huang Mangchang is the most common and has the highest moral standards, so they are called the four major families by the world. According to legend, Hu Santaiye and Hu Santai are the most famous in the family, and they are responsible for leading and supervising the immortal families in the world.
In order to practice or accept a mission, the Immortal family wants to accumulate merit, achieve righteousness, and save the world, but it is not convenient to directly transform into a human being to avoid shocking the world. Therefore, they choose human beings with immortality and understanding as Xiangtong to cooperate with them and save the world in the form of possession. People like Wang Pozi are this type of people.
Okay, let’s stop talking here and let’s get to the point without further ado.
I saw Mrs. Wang talking nonsense for a while, then she opened her eyes suddenly, hiccupped incessantly, and said intermittently: "Uh, what do you, uh, two of you mean to invite me here?"
At this time, Mrs. Wang's voice was very stiff. It was not her previous voice. It was neither male nor female. Her tone was a bit sharp and a bit jerky.
My mother knew that Mrs. Wang had become an immortal, and she quickly pointed at the unconscious me and said, "Xianjia, please help me find out what happened to the child Shuangxi. He was fine just now, but suddenly he fainted. I couldn't wake him up even if I shouted."
Mrs. Wang glanced at me, hummed softly, then closed her eyes, put her hands on her knees, twisted them, and started counting.
After a while, she opened her eyes and said: "This child, uh, has lost his soul. But the soul, uh, has gone to a place it shouldn't go. Even I, uh, dare not go there. This matter, uh, is not easy to handle."
Anyone who likes to exorcise ghosts?
